decisions.statement: Who a seat is is answered as a read rather than through a command.
A seat launch reads who the seat is over the payload rather than through a second call.
One key per line is the contract with the caller.
An attribute a seat does not state prints the word null.
A line left off would read as an empty value rather than an absent value.
This module reads the seat this module names rather than the caller's own.
A call naming no agent is refused.

definition: one seat call read off a payload, for the shell that launches a seat
